description: Hauts-de-Seine - aménagements cyclables is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Tracés des aménagements cyclables réalisés (ou en cours de réalisation) par le Département des Hauts-de-Seine Au travers de son Plan de développement des circulations douces, le Département des Hauts-de-Seine soutient l’utilisation du vélo en tant que mode de déplacement alternatif à la voiture avec comme enjeu le développement durable. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Déplacements - transports. Its keywords are Vélo, Déplacements, Circulation douce, Géolocalisation. The portal shows 9,025 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-11-12 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
